sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Heals 20% of max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
Increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
